baseline._doc: N3 (2026-09-26 laptop + CI re-audit): this baseline used to also carry the author's own global_claude_md, every @-include, ecc_rules_common, workspace_claude_md, skill_catalog_global and skill_catalog_plugins — all machine-specific facts about ONE person's ~/.claude, not about this product. Shipped as-is by the installer, every OTHER machine's first doctor run got a `source_vanished` finding (an honest zero on their machine read as 'the meter is under-reporting') purely because it wasn't the author's machine. Only PRODUCT-OWNED surfaces are baselined now: this project's own CLAUDE.md and its own .claude/skills. A user's global chain and plugin/skill catalogs are never compared against these numbers. Re-run `--write-baseline` after a deliberate change to this project's CLAUDE.md or its skill set.
baseline.estimate_note: ESTIMATE ONLY: tokens are characters / chars_per_token. No tokenizer ran — these are not exact token counts. Calibrate against a real /context reading before treating any of them as a hard budget.
